policy: Every machine lesson keeps its production source and proof, but only project-advancing material enters the sequential book.

entries.title: The program we could no longer see
entries.concept_proof: The checked origin composite separates hidden realization from one visible semantic program.
entries.reader_payoff: Understand why Conduit exists before learning its vocabulary.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep the Tongues to PETE to Conduit lineage as the prologue and lead directly into the instrument.

entries.title: Evictable large-value cache
entries.concept_proof: Five checked scenarios prove bounded cache composition, removal, rejection, resource identity and cancellation.
entries.reader_payoff: Choose finite cache behavior when a real service needs it.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep as a focused storage recipe rather than a sequential stop.

entries.title: Hello, panel
entries.concept_proof: Minimal literal-to-display execution remains a parser, resolver and runtime fixture.
entries.reader_payoff: Inspect the smallest retained fixture only when debugging or learning the grammar.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Remove from the curriculum; explain that the living instrument replaced it while retaining the exact fixture.

entries.title: Pull the cord
entries.concept_proof: An incomplete authored cord remains visible and fails closed.
entries.reader_payoff: See the same failure inside a meaningful project patch.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Fold deliberate breakage into the instrument feedback section.

entries.title: Change the message
entries.concept_proof: A local source edit reruns through production semantics.
entries.reader_payoff: Retain as an editing fixture without pretending a field change is a project.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Move editing and recovery into cumulative project state.

entries.title: Nothing up our sleeves
entries.concept_proof: Plan and evidence drawers trace one exact run.
entries.reader_payoff: Open proof only after a project result creates the question.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Fold proof into the service evidence notebook.

entries.title: More than one port
entries.concept_proof: A composite exposes multiple independently typed ports.
entries.reader_payoff: Read the instrument mixer and robot boundaries when they need more than one signal.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep port anatomy searchable; introduce it in prose only when a project adds a second signal.

entries.title: Direction matters
entries.concept_proof: A reversed semantic endpoint fails with the authoritative diagnostic.
entries.reader_payoff: Understand a local wiring failure without memorizing a standalone lesson.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Use as the exact failure reference linked from project diagnostics.

entries.title: Fan-out is a choice
entries.concept_proof: An explicit tee owns duplication and coupled pressure.
entries.reader_payoff: Give the instrument a second rhythm without treating a drawn fork as free.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Introduce tee only because the instrument needs two rhythmic layers.

entries.title: Types mean promises
entries.concept_proof: Semantic contract substitution rejects incompatible nearby ports.
entries.reader_payoff: Inspect why a project connection cannot carry the required signal.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep the compatibility proof searchable and link it from project failures.

entries.title: Empty is not never
entries.concept_proof: Value absence and terminal state remain separate facts.
entries.reader_payoff: Explain Waiting and service lifecycle without a vocabulary detour.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Motivate terminal meaning when the service has no request yet but remains alive.

entries.title: Put a panel in a panel
entries.concept_proof: A checked composite definition executes without copying its implementation.
entries.reader_payoff: Package a project subsystem behind a readable faceplate.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep as a focused composition recipe.

entries.title: The jacks on the front
entries.concept_proof: Public composite ports stay distinct from private realization.
entries.reader_payoff: Expose only the controls a project operator needs.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep faceplate export anatomy in Reference.

entries.title: Inside / outside
entries.concept_proof: Logical and expanded topology projections share semantic identities.
entries.reader_payoff: Move between project surface and realization without changing the program.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep projection controls discoverable outside the reading sequence.

entries.title: Reuse without copying
entries.concept_proof: One semantic definition can have distinct exact realizations.
entries.reader_payoff: Reuse project pieces while preserving meaning and replacement boundaries.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep as an optional composition recipe.

entries.title: A live ticker Watch
entries.concept_proof: A production ticker remains live in one exact worker session and Watch observes without semantic demand.
entries.reader_payoff: Wake a living visual instrument immediately and see that it stays alive until Stop.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Make this the first build result rather than an isolated Watch catalog entry.

entries.title: Patchbay observes Patchbay
entries.concept_proof: The timeline and evidence table project the same ordered execution record.
entries.reader_payoff: Attach an evidence notebook after the instrument needs trustworthy observation.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Use after non-invasive Watch creates the question of trustworthy observation.

entries.title: Typed text formatting
entries.concept_proof: Six checked paths cover typed formatting, lines, joining, missing input and cancellation.
entries.reader_payoff: Format project output without making string fields a chapter.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep as a focused recipe.

entries.title: Bounded media values without hidden codecs
entries.concept_proof: Checked media frame values retain explicit format, shape and byte bounds.
entries.reader_payoff: Inspect exact media representation when adding explicit sound later.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep media value contracts in Reference; the non-audio instrument remains complete.

entries.title: Mix a standing audio patch without hidden DSP
entries.concept_proof: Eight checked audio contracts keep coupled fan-out, PCM arithmetic, timing, layout, history, pressure, meter observation and standing lifecycle explicit.
entries.reader_payoff: Build a traditional standing audio patch without turning it into a command list or hiding conversion and state.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep as a focused standing-audio recipe with exact non-audio observation.

entries.title: Connect a standing patch to explicit audio devices
entries.concept_proof: Capture and playback bind distinct observed resources, negotiation, clocks, authority, pressure and lifecycle around one continuing bounded composition.
entries.reader_payoff: Connect a patch to real or virtual audio without accepting an ambient default, hidden conversion, or a clean-looking device failure.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep as the focused observed-device recipe beside host-neutral audio processing.

entries.title: Exact PCM/WAVE operations without ambient codecs
entries.concept_proof: PCM and WAVE transformations run through exact codec providers and bounds.
entries.reader_payoff: Add explicit sound encoding without treating host codecs as ambient truth.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep as an optional sound-export recipe.

entries.title: Frames and calibration without an ambient world
entries.concept_proof: Checked transforms require explicit frames, calibration and bounded interpolation.
entries.reader_payoff: Inspect spatial meaning when a future project needs it.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep outside the first book projects.

entries.title: Bounded scans become maps without becoming a world model
entries.concept_proof: Checked scans, trajectories and grid snapshots retain explicit frame, time, calibration, representation and finite bounds.
entries.reader_payoff: Turn bounded spatial observations into exact finite maps without importing an ambient world model.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep as a focused scan, trajectory and map recipe outside the first book projects.

entries.title: Exact learned inference without ambient models
entries.concept_proof: Inference binds exact model, runtime and device identities under bounded work.
entries.reader_payoff: Use models later without confusing availability with semantic authority.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep as an optional learned-inference recipe.

entries.title: Describe a robot without touching it
entries.concept_proof: Real Linux and Pico W descriptions implement one robotics profile through generic host conformance while remaining effect-free and non-executable.
entries.reader_payoff: Inspect what a robot host could provide without mistaking inventory, discovery, role or capability for live state or motion authority.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep the effect-free cross-host robotics inventory as an exact reference outside the sequential project path.

entries.title: Quick local chat without an ambient model
entries.concept_proof: One chat contract binds deterministic and observed local implementations while preserving bounded context, output, authority, retention and terminal facts.
entries.reader_payoff: Use a useful local text provider without putting its server, model discovery or authority into the graph.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep as a focused provider-neutral chat recipe.

entries.title: A good metric cannot promote a model
entries.concept_proof: Training and evaluation remain bounded and unprivileged while promotion requires a separate exact grant and acknowledged receipt.
entries.reader_payoff: Keep useful metrics separate from authority when a product gains a model lifecycle.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep as an optional governed model-lifecycle recipe.

entries.title: Citations that keep their source revision
entries.concept_proof: Retrieval output carries bounded citations tied to source revision.
entries.reader_payoff: Build source-grounded knowledge features without ambient claims.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep as a focused knowledge recipe.

entries.title: A graph edge is not a citation
entries.concept_proof: Cited-claim traversal preserves support on every admitted edge.
entries.reader_payoff: Traverse bounded knowledge without upgrading adjacency into evidence.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep as a focused graph recipe.

entries.title: Bounded flow control
entries.concept_proof: Checked tee, merge, zip, gate and select nodes retain bounded delivery semantics.
entries.reader_payoff: Add a second instrument rhythm and bound a service queue only when those projects need branching.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Introduce only the flow operation required by the current project obstacle.

entries.title: Bounded in-run state
entries.concept_proof: Checked cell, deduplicate and cache behavior retains explicit finite state.
entries.reader_payoff: Let the instrument remember and the service retain only bounded facts.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Introduce state because the instrument must remember a prior moment.

entries.title: Retry and break without changing the plan
entries.concept_proof: Retry and circuit-breaker scenarios keep policy finite and plan-visible.
entries.reader_payoff: Keep the service useful when one worker fails.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Introduce supervision only after a deliberate service worker failure.

entries.title: Explicit bounded time
entries.concept_proof: Delay, timeout, debounce and throttle use named clocks and finite retained work.
entries.reader_payoff: Give the instrument rhythm and the service explicit time without ambient timers.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Introduce time because the visible instrument needs repeatable rhythm.

entries.title: Bounded value facts, clocks, and feedback
entries.concept_proof: The exact plan admits finite envelope facts, clock conversion and feedback boundaries while rejecting zero-delay recurrence.
entries.reader_payoff: Make motion smooth and feedback finite in the living instrument.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Pair the invalid zero-delay cycle with its repaired bounded feedback patch.

entries.title: Finite leases and honest effect commits
entries.concept_proof: Lease, authority, commit and cleanup facts fail closed across acknowledgement loss.
entries.reader_payoff: Let simulated Pete stop safely without granting physical actuation.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Introduce leases only when the rehearsal reaches a simulated effect boundary.

entries.title: Deadline guarantees are not measurements
entries.concept_proof: Hard admission stays distinct from Linux measurements, browser best effort and unsupported profiles.
entries.reader_payoff: Degrade the rehearsal honestly when a host cannot uphold timing.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Introduce deadline evidence when the rehearsal needs a time-bound safety response.

entries.title: One media node, several implementations
entries.concept_proof: One unchanged media contract resolves through exact reference, process, and browser implementations.
entries.reader_payoff: Choose where the simulated robot graph can run without changing authored meaning.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Introduce generic implementation selection when the rehearsal crosses hosts.

entries.title: Representations are explicit boundaries
entries.concept_proof: Round-trip and validation scenarios keep data representations explicit.
entries.reader_payoff: Adapt project data without ambient coercion.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep as a focused adapter recipe.

entries.title: Bounded process execution
entries.concept_proof: Process execution declares streams, cancellation, cleanup and browser unavailability explicitly.
entries.reader_payoff: Understand a host boundary without derailing the browser-local projects.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep provider-unavailable truth in Reference.

entries.title: Bounded TCP and UDP sockets
entries.concept_proof: TCP and UDP declarations retain finite sessions, queues, cancellation and browser rejection.
entries.reader_payoff: See a failed cross-host path during the robot rehearsal without pretending the browser has a socket provider.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Use browser unavailability as the deliberate path failure and degrade explicitly.

entries.title: A persistent bounded HTTP service
entries.concept_proof: HTTP request, listener, session, cancellation and provider-loss scenarios remain bounded and exact.
entries.reader_payoff: Build a service intended to stay alive and explain browser provider absence honestly.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Start from the persistent service outcome, then reveal Waiting and provider boundaries.

entries.title: Bounded file boundaries
entries.concept_proof: Read, write, watch, wrong-handle and cancellation scenarios use explicit browser resources.
entries.reader_payoff: Add storage to a service through a bounded resource when needed.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep as an optional service storage recipe.

entries.title: A small isolated network without robot authority
entries.concept_proof: Isolated access point, DHCP, ICMP, discovery and attachment lease fixtures explicitly forbid routing, bridging and robot authority.
entries.reader_payoff: Start a safe Pete rehearsal whose network cannot acquire motion authority.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Make this the safe rehearsal result, explicitly simulated and non-actuating.

entries.title: One program, four different records
entries.concept_proof: Source, candidate/exact plan, active run and evidence keep separate identities.
entries.reader_payoff: Ask what record proves a service or rehearsal claim without making metadata the project payoff.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Place as an optional evidence-notebook interlude after the service has something worth proving.

entries.title: Ask once; act with bounded cancellation
entries.concept_proof: Allocator-free reference fixtures and a browser-readable projection preserve correlated identities, admission proofs, bounded feedback, cancellation and distinct terminal outcomes.
entries.reader_payoff: Choose one bounded request/reply exchange or a cancellable admitted action without importing RPC, callbacks or hidden authority.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep the full standalone and composition story as a focused control recipe with accessible textual timelines.

entries.title: Imports name meaning; plans provide machines
entries.concept_proof: Offline contract-package imports resolve meaning without acquiring providers, authority or execution.
entries.reader_payoff: Reuse semantic definitions without smuggling machines into the book path.
entries.narrative_rewrite: Keep package identity and contract-only status in Reference.
